check_and_continue: Tap Check and continue to check the interrupted update before continuing.
review_rescue_on_mac: Review the rescue on the Mac. If no update is running, clear the rescue marker.
review_recovery: Review the failed update and recovery on the Mac before trying another update.
upgrade_on_mac: Complete the attended upgrade on the Mac.
rescue_resolved: The rescue marker was cleared. Your rescue review is resolved.
review_refused_update: Review the refused update on the Mac. Nothing was changed, so retrying is safe.
review_rolled_back_update: Review the rollback on the Mac. The previous known-good version is back.
